title: Quinn Damerell's original website — January 2011
scope: Same-site pages reachable from the exact requested homepage, plus referenced image, CSS, script, and downloadable resources. External navigation destinations are not recursively crawled. Every discovered resource is recorded as recovered or unavailable with bounded retrieval evidence. Every resource records its actual capture date; copies more than one year from the target are labeled supplements.
static_changes: Rewrote same-site links and resource paths to lowercase local files; distinct content-query variants use a stable hash in the filename.

Removed tracking and original executable scripts; preserved their raw source as inert text. Reimplemented photo accordion/gallery and video-tab selection with an audited local helper; hover artwork could not be recovered, so navigation uses its original normal-state images.
Converted handler-only navigation into real local links; labeled image navigation for accessibility and repaired the existing TxtBack fragment link to its matching project paragraph.
Disabled forms and account/server actions. Flash/Java embeds are source links, not emulated; external videos open at their original publisher.

Gallery thumbnails/full images substitute for their own missing counterpart only when paired in the original source, with an explicit note and per-image provenance. Replaced unavailable images with an explicit placeholder; missing background assets are transparent. Unavailable site pages have a local notice.
Preserved original source bytes with exact capture provenance and SHA-256; the served copies are separately hashed.
